website_summary.name: AI Agent Workflow Manager
website_summary.description: The website provides a clean, organized interface for managing AI agents, tasks, and workflows within projects.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a modern and intuitive design with a sidebar navigation menu on the left and a main content area on the right. The sidebar includes sections for Projects, Workflows, Agents, and Tasks, each with expandable lists and "Create New" buttons. The main content area displays a tabbed interface for Workflows, Agents, and Tasks, with a detailed table view for each tab. The tables include columns for various attributes like Name, Description, Type, and Actions, with options to sort, filter, and paginate data. The overall layout is responsive, adapting well to different screen sizes.
website_summary.functionality:
The website enables users to create and manage AI agents, tasks, and workflows within specific projects. Key functionalities include:
- Creating new workflows, agents, and tasks via dedicated buttons that open creation forms.
- Viewing and editing details of workflows, agents, and tasks through interactive tables.
- Associating workflows, agents, and tasks with specific projects.
- Performing actions like viewing and deleting entries directly from the tables.
- Navigating between different projects and their associated entities using the sidebar and project selection dropdown.

functionality_testing.name: Assigned Agent Selection Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that selecting an agent from the Assigned Agent dropdown assigns the agent to the task.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The selected agent should be displayed in the "Assigned Agent" field. 7. Next Steps : Click on the "Assigned Agent" dropdown to select an agent.
procedure: Click on the Assigned Agent dropdown.
Select an agent from the list.

functionality_testing.name: Create Task Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Create Task button initiates the task creation process.
functionality_testing.expected_results: A new task creation form should appear. 7. Next Steps : Click on the "Create Task" button to proceed with task creation.
procedure: Click on the Create Task button.

functionality_testing.name: Create Workflow Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the "Create Workflow" button successfully initiates workflow creation.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Within the Workflows section of the sidebar.
functionality_testing.expected_results: A new window or form for workflow creation should appear whenever the "Create Workflow" button is clicked.
procedure: Verify that the form for creating the workflow appears.

functionality_testing.name: Tasks Navigation Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Tasks button navigates to the Tasks section.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The page should switch to the Tasks section. 7. Next Steps : Click on the Tasks tab to proceed with task creation.

functionality_testing.name: Thought Process Input Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Thought Process Textarea correctly accepts and displays the entered thought process.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Workflow creation form is open, and the Workflow Name field is filled.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The Thought Process Textarea should display the text "This is the thought process for the new workflow." accurately, and the validation error message should disappear.
procedure: Type "This is the thought process for the new workflow." into the Thought Process Textarea.
Verify that the entered text is displayed correctly in the field and the validation error message disappears.

functionality_testing.name: Understanding the User Input Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Understanding the User Textarea correctly accepts and displays the entered user understanding.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Workflow creation form is open, and the Workflow Name and Thought Process fields are filled.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The Understanding the User Textarea should display the text "This is the understanding of the user for the new workflow." accurately.
procedure: Type "This is the understanding of the user for the new workflow." into the Understanding the User Textarea.
Verify that the entered text is displayed correctly in the field.

functionality_testing.name: Workflow Name Input Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Workflow Name Input Field correctly accepts and displays the entered workflow name.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The Workflow Name Input Field should display the text "New Workflow" accurately.
procedure: Type "New Workflow" into the Workflow Name Input Field.
Verify that the entered text is displayed correctly in the field.

procedure: Observe the alignment of sidebar elements.
Verify that elements are stacked vertically and aligned properly.

data_display_testing.name: Sidebar Element Alignment Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the sidebar elements maintain proper alignment.

procedure: Observe the alignment of sidebar elements.

data_display_testing.name: Visual Appeal Test

Verify that the UI looks clean and balanced.
